as_of_note: End of the PRE_TEST window. A player whose first T20I in the data is later is NOT treated as Capped for PRE_TEST scoring.

squad_corroboration.note: A squad team group is mapped to a team_id by the plurality of its uniquely resolved players (id-keyed evidence from competition_team_player_mapping). Team names are never joined as text.

status_semantics.Capped: Only DERIVED_FROM_OFFICIAL_T20I_APPEARANCES (listed in a T20I playing eleven on or before as_of_date) or a manual override.
status_semantics.Uncapped: Only VERIFIED_FROM_SOURCE via a manual override or a source file. Never inferred from absence in the data.
status_semantics.Unknown: Everything else, including players never seen in a T20I.

source_needed: An official or verified list of international caps keyed by player_id, or by player name plus team (for example a squad sheet with a capped/uncapped column), plus player_id keys for squad names that do not resolve.
